FORM.notes: source note: P.S. | source note: (1) =cu我還沒有改掉，因為我記得上次老師說要和奕揚學長說好後再一起改，而且SOP裡面也沒有說如何標示「已經」。 | source note: (2) KuatU的名字最後一個字母是有刪除線的u，目前檔名我都還沒有更動(包括metadata裡的檔名)，但發音人我已經寫成KuatU。請協助修改這項資訊。 | source note: kari有「語言」和「話」兩個意思。

S.FORM: sua tia sua tia karimaku ia.
S.PHON: sua tia sua tia ka[r|ɾ]imaku ia
S.FORM: sua tia sua tia karimaku ia.
S.PHON: sua tia sua tia ka[r|ɾ]imaku ia
S.TRANSL: 我要說的是……
What I am going to talk is...

FORM.notes: source note: cani pininga為一詞組，意為「家庭」。 | source note: pininga為「廣場(空曠的地方)」，非「庭院」的概念。 | source note: can相當於cani。

S.FORM: teku poisua cani piningamaku miana.
S.PHON: teku poisua ʦani piniŋamaku miana
S.FORM: teku poisua cani piningamaku miana.
S.PHON: teku poisua ʦani piniŋamaku miana
S.TRANSL: 我要講我以前的家庭.
I am going to say about my previous family.

FORM.notes: source note: aranai實為「從……開始」，有標示出起點；另一個相關的字matiananai意為「開始」，無標示起點。 | source note: me-cocua為「兩個人一起行動」的意思，發音人後來覺得不好，改使用'arup-ara「結婚」這個用語。其他相關的用語：mecicin「單獨一個人」、「孤獨」；mecococua「一直都是兩個人(一起行動)」；maracicin「一個人走」(mocaca：「走」)；maracocua「兩人一起走」。

S.FORM: aranaiku miana er mecocua ma er 'arupara mataa 'Angai.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anaiku miana e[r|ɾ] meʦoʦua ma e[r|ɾ] ʔa[r|ɾ]upa[r|ɾ]a mataa ʔaŋai
S.FORM: aranaiku miana er mecocua ma er 'arupara mataa 'Angai.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anaiku miana e[r|ɾ] meʦoʦua ma e[r|ɾ] ʔa[r|ɾ]upa[r|ɾ]a mataa ʔaŋai
S.TRANSL: 我從以前,跟Angai結婚.
I got married with 'Angai in the past.

FORM.notes: source note: 本IU直譯為「沒有了'Angai的老人家」。 | source note: 根據Wu (2006)，=cu為Change of State的標記，類似中文的「了」。以下同。 | source note: 根據發音老師，有另外一個mamia，意為「可惜」。

S.FORM: 'akiacu mamarangin 'Angai mecocuakim mamia.
S.PHON: ʔakiaʦu mama[r|ɾ]aŋin ʔaŋai meʦoʦuakim mamia
S.FORM: 'akiacu mamarangin 'Angai mecocuakim mamia.
S.PHON: ʔakiaʦu mama[r|ɾ]aŋin ʔaŋai meʦoʦuakim mamia
S.TRANSL: 'Angai的父母過世了;只有我們兩個在一起.
'Angai's parents had died; only we two were together.

W.TRANSL: 主焦-兩人一起行動=1EPL.主格

FORM.notes: source note: 根據發音老師，arane為aranai的變音，意思不變。 | source note: =kia雖本為單數，但許多地方亦擁有複數的意味(即「我們」)。見之後的句子。 | source note: mo-'uma「作農」泛指作農地裡的所有工作。

S.FORM: er arane miana miaranasʉkia mo'uma.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] a[r|ɾ]ane miana mia[r|ɾ]anasɨkia moʔuma
S.FORM: er arane miana miaranasʉkia mo'uma.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] a[r|ɾ]ane miana mia[r|ɾ]anasɨkia moʔuma
S.TRANSL: 從以前開始,我(們)就很困苦的作農.
Since the past, I (we) have been tough transplanting seedlings.

S.FORM: u no mia 'unacikia manu ia miaranasʉkia putukikio sii nuu ca'ania ia tumatang manu.
S.PHON: u no mia ʔunaʦikia manu ia mia[r|ɾ]anasɨkia putukikio sii nuu ʦaʔania ia tumataŋ manu
S.FORM: u no mia 'unacikia manu ia miaranasʉkia putukikio sii nuu ca'ania ia tumatang manu.
S.PHON: u no mia ʔunaʦikia manu ia mia[r|ɾ]anasɨkia putukikio sii nuu ʦaʔania ia tumataŋ manu
S.TRANSL: 當我有了孩子的時候,我很困苦的工作,因為白天的時候小孩子在哭泣.
When I got the children, I was tough working, because the children cried during the daytime.

S.FORM: macici taniarʉ ia 'esi tumatang manu.
S.PHON: maʦiʦi tania[r|ɾ]ɨ ia ʔesi tumataŋ manu
S.FORM: macici taniarʉ ia 'esi tumatang manu.
S.PHON: maʦiʦi tania[r|ɾ]ɨ ia ʔesi tumataŋ manu
S.TRANSL: 太陽很熱,小孩子在哭泣.
The sun was hot and the children was crying.

S.FORM: nuu 'umo'ucanin ia miaranasʉkia sii 'akia taru'an.
S.PHON: nuu ʔumoʔuʦanin ia mia[r|ɾ]anasɨkia sii ʔakia ta[r|ɾ]uʔan
S.FORM: nuu 'umo'ucanin ia miaranasʉkia sii 'akia taru'an.
S.PHON: nuu ʔumoʔuʦanin ia mia[r|ɾ]anasɨkia sii ʔakia ta[r|ɾ]uʔan
S.TRANSL: 如果下雨的話,我很困苦,因為沒有工寮.
If it rained I was tough, because there were no workmen's huts.

FORM.notes: source note: ma-ka-sua合起來為的意思為「那樣」(ma+ka+isua)。之後的glossing將不把這個字拆開，而是採用合起來的翻譯。ma-ka-si「這樣」有類似的構詞法，見第49個IU。

S.FORM: er makasua er miaranasʉ putukikio.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makasua e[r|ɾ] mia[r|ɾ]anasɨ putukikio
S.FORM: er makasua er miaranasʉ putukikio.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makasua e[r|ɾ] mia[r|ɾ]anasɨ putukikio
S.TRANSL: (我)那樣困苦的工作.
(I) was tough in that way.

S.FORM: er tatiacu manu arʉncu cau.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] tatiaʦu manu a[r|ɾ]ɨnʦu ʦau
S.FORM: er tatiacu manu arʉncu cau.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] tatiaʦu manu a[r|ɾ]ɨnʦu ʦau
S.TRANSL: 孩子長大了,別人娶走了.
The children grew up, and they were taken by others.

FORM.notes: source note: 「男性」發音老師發為saronai。

S.FORM: er 'akia manumaku sarunei kara kaira nannakʉ.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] ʔakia manumaku sa[r|ɾ]unei ka[r|ɾ]a kai[r|ɾ]a nannakɨ
S.FORM: er 'akia manumaku sarunei kara kaira nannakʉ.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] ʔakia manumaku sa[r|ɾ]unei ka[r|ɾ]a kai[r|ɾ]a nannakɨ
S.TRANSL: 我沒有男孩,都是女的.
I don't have boys; all are girls.

FORM.notes: source note: 'eci由'esi cu合併而來。 | source note: rU'UvU除了「伴侶」外，尚有「夥伴」的含義。「配偶」為'ucang。

S.FORM: arʉncu cau kangvang 'ecikim mamia mecocua mataa rʉ'ʉvʉmaku.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]ɨnʦu ʦau kaŋvaŋ ʔeʦikim mamia meʦoʦua mataa [r|ɾ]ɨʔɨvɨmaku
S.FORM: arʉncu cau kangvang 'ecikim mamia mecocua mataa rʉ'ʉvʉmaku.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]ɨnʦu ʦau kaŋvaŋ ʔeʦikim mamia meʦoʦua mataa [r|ɾ]ɨʔɨvɨmaku
S.TRANSL: 所有(小孩)都被人娶走了,就只有和我的伴侶,我們兩個人在一起.
(My children) were all taken away by others, we two were together, only (I) and my mate.

FORM.notes: source note: 根據發音老師，marang有下列意思：「老人」；「父母」；「老(人或動植物)(動詞)」；「年長(動詞)」；「年紀大了(動詞)」。

S.FORM: er makasua marangcukia.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makasua ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦukia
S.FORM: er makasua marangcukia.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makasua ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦukia
S.TRANSL: 就那樣,我老了.
In that way, I turned old.

FORM.notes: source note: ma-man的重疊表示複數，而發音老師對於小孩(複數)的說法為manu-manu。 | source note: 根據發音老師，此處的arU相當於受焦形式的arUn。

S.FORM: miaranasʉ putukikio 'akia moran sii niarʉcu cau kangvang mamanmaku.
S.PHON: mia[r|ɾ]anasɨ putukikio ʔakia mo[r|ɾ]an sii nia[r|ɾ]ɨʦu ʦau kaŋvaŋ mamanmaku
S.FORM: miaranasʉ putukikio 'akia moran sii niarʉcu cau kangvang mamanmaku.
S.PHON: mia[r|ɾ]anasɨ putukikio ʔakia mo[r|ɾ]an sii nia[r|ɾ]ɨʦu ʦau kaŋvaŋ mamanmaku
S.TRANSL: 我很困苦的工作,沒有(人)幫(我),因為我的小孩全部被娶走了.
I was tough working, and no (one) helped (me), because my kids had all been taken by others.

FORM.notes: source note: makahua由makasua而來(女性較喜歡用前者)。 | source note: nuu由noo而來。以下同。 | source note: 「揹」主焦型式為m-ava。

S.FORM: er makahua putukikiokia nuu nuu er miana ia cumacancukia ʉ avʉʉn manu cumacancu.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makahua putukikiokia nuu nuu e[r|ɾ] miana ia ʦumaʦanʦukia ɨ avɨɨn manu ʦumaʦanʦu
S.FORM: er makahua putukikiokia nuu nuu er miana ia cumacancukia ʉ avʉʉn manu cumacancu.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makahua putukikiokia nuu nuu e[r|ɾ] miana ia ʦumaʦanʦukia ɨ avɨɨn manu ʦumaʦanʦu
S.TRANSL: 我(們)那樣的工作,以前呢,我(們)插秧,揹著小孩插秧.
We worked in that way; in the past we transplanted seedlings, children being carried on the back.

S.FORM: 'apanapen 'apanapa nuu tia matapari'i manu sii avʉʉn avʉʉn na kukuca.
S.PHON: ʔapanapen ʔapanapa nuu tia matapa[r|ɾ]iʔi manu sii avɨɨn avɨɨn na kukuʦa
S.FORM: 'apanapen 'apanapa nuu tia matapari'i manu sii avʉʉn avʉʉn na kukuca.
S.PHON: ʔapanapen ʔapanapa nuu tia matapa[r|ɾ]iʔi manu sii avɨɨn avɨɨn na kukuʦa
S.TRANSL: 因為是背在後面,有時候小孩會掉下來.
Because (the children) were carried on the back, sometimes the children would fall down.

S.FORM: ah aka cʉpʉng tecikia manan putukikio sii makahua manu um 'esi tumatang.
S.PHON: ah aka ʦɨpɨŋ teʦikia manan putukikio sii makahua manu um ʔesi tumataŋ
S.FORM: ah aka cʉpʉng tecikia manan putukikio sii makahua manu um 'esi tumatang.
S.PHON: ah aka ʦɨpɨŋ teʦikia manan putukikio sii makahua manu um ʔesi tumataŋ
S.TRANSL: 因為小孩子那樣哭著,(我)心裡很難過;我要怎麼工作?
Because the children were crying in such a way, I felt sad; how could I work?

FORM.notes: source note: mama'ari有以下意義：(精神)舒緩；(病痛或健康)稍可了/稍好了；還好/還可以。 | source note: matarava不等於「抵達(某地)(matacʉkʉna)」，而是指時間到了。

S.FORM: er makahuakia miaranasʉ aratatiacu manu mama'aricu um matarava mamisa masin.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makahuakia mia[r|ɾ]anasɨ a[r|ɾ]atatiaʦu manu mamaʔa[r|ɾ]iʦu um mata[r|ɾ]ava mamisa masin
S.FORM: er makahuakia miaranasʉ aratatiacu manu mama'aricu um matarava mamisa masin.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makahuakia mia[r|ɾ]anasɨ a[r|ɾ]atatiaʦu manu mamaʔa[r|ɾ]iʦu um mata[r|ɾ]ava mamisa masin
S.TRANSL: 我那樣困苦著.小孩變大了,到了現在,(狀況)就稍好了.
I was tough in that way. The children have grown up; at the moment (the condition) is better.

FORM.notes: source translation placeholder omitted: en=....; zho=……。

S.FORM: er 'ecikia mamia mecocua mataa rʉ'ʉvʉ sii. XXXX
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] ʔeʦikia mamia meʦoʦua mataa [r|ɾ]ɨʔɨvɨ sii ****
S.FORM: er 'ecikia mamia mecocua mataa rʉ'ʉvʉ sii. XXXX
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] ʔeʦikia mamia meʦoʦua mataa [r|ɾ]ɨʔɨvɨ sii ****

FORM.notes: source note: pipining有「外頭」、「外面」、「廣場」等意思。 | source note: ha相當於sua。 | source note: takacincin有「各自」、「獨自」、「一人」、「主動做……」等意思。 | source note: mari原形為mara，意為「拿」；類似的構詞如mari-vinaU「收割小米」。

S.FORM: pipining kangvang ha maman takacicincu ʉ marinupasʉ.
S.PHON: pipiniŋ kaŋvaŋ ha maman takaʦiʦinʦu ɨ ma[r|ɾ]inupasɨ
S.FORM: pipining kangvang ha maman takacicincu ʉ marinupasʉ.
S.PHON: pipiniŋ kaŋvaŋ ha maman takaʦiʦinʦu ɨ ma[r|ɾ]inupasɨ
S.TRANSL: 我只有跟我的伴侶兩人在一起,因為我的小孩們都在外頭獨自賺錢.
I was together with my mate in that way, because all of my childred were outside earning money by ourselves.

FORM.notes: source note: 根據發音老師，noo/nuu經常會伴隨後綴=in。兩者同時出現或任一出現，都能表達「如果」的意思。

S.FORM: nuu matarava nuu kaisisin cina ia iavatu tanasa maman ara.
S.PHON: nuu mata[r|ɾ]ava nuu kaisisin ʦina ia iavatu tanasa maman a[r|ɾ]a
S.FORM: nuu matarava nuu kaisisin cina ia iavatu tanasa maman ara.
S.PHON: nuu mata[r|ɾ]ava nuu kaisisin ʦina ia iavatu tanasa maman a[r|ɾ]a
S.TRANSL: 若到了媽媽的節日,小孩就來到家.
When Mother's Day came, the children came home.

FORM.notes: source note: 'esi用來表達存在與否，而mon則是表達在某處做什麼。 | source note: 本IU的最後也可說...mon na kamua，感覺更為正式。

S.FORM: um movua nupasʉ tia 'urupacamu cina cuma sii 'ancikim tavarʉ'ʉ mon kamua.
S.PHON: um movua nupasɨ tia ʔu[r|ɾ]upaʦamu ʦina ʦuma sii ʔanʦikim tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ mon kamua
S.FORM: um movua nupasʉ tia 'urupacamu cina cuma sii 'ancikim tavarʉ'ʉ mon kamua.
S.PHON: um movua nupasɨ tia ʔu[r|ɾ]upaʦamu ʦina ʦuma sii ʔanʦikim tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ mon kamua
S.TRANSL: ＂(這些錢)是要給媽媽爸爸你們使用的金錢,因為我們不能住你們那裡.
"(We) give money to you mother and father to use, because we cannot live in your place.

S.FORM: sii 'ekia pipining kavanvantuku.
S.PHON: sii ʔekia pipiniŋ kavanvantuku
S.FORM: sii 'ekia pipining kavanvantuku.
S.PHON: sii ʔekia pipiniŋ kavanvantuku
S.TRANSL: 因為我們在外面賺錢.
Because we are earning money outside.

S.FORM: er makasuacu mama'aricu cʉpʉng nuu makasuin.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makasuaʦu mamaʔa[r|ɾ]iʦu ʦɨpɨŋ nuu makasuin
S.FORM: er makasuacu mama'aricu cʉpʉng nuu makasuin.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] makasuaʦu mamaʔa[r|ɾ]iʦu ʦɨpɨŋ nuu makasuin
S.TRANSL: 就那樣了.如果那樣的話,心裡就舒坦了.
The condition was like so. In that way, my heart would be relieved.

S.FORM: marangcikia pairacu mamia musukom.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦikia pai[r|ɾ]aʦu mamia musukom
S.FORM: marangcikia pairacu mamia musukom.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦikia pai[r|ɾ]aʦu mamia musukom
S.TRANSL: 我老了,只會經常生病.
I am already old (and) can only get sick often.

S.FORM: akacu tina'an 'ancikia tavarʉ'ʉ putukikio.
S.PHON: akaʦu tinaʔan ʔanʦikia tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ putukikio
S.FORM: akacu tina'an 'ancikia tavarʉ'ʉ putukikio.
S.PHON: akaʦu tinaʔan ʔanʦikia tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ putukikio
S.TRANSL: 身體不好了,我不能工作了.
(Because) my body is not well, I cannot work.

FORM.notes: source note: tatingi等同於tati'ing，但尚不確定哪個是起源字。 | source note: ma-ka-si合起來的意思為「這樣」(ma+ka+isi)，類似ma-ka-sua「那樣」(見第15個IU)。 | source note: mamarurang/mamarang指的是「老人家」(只能指人)，但marang「變老(動詞)」可以用在人、動物或是樹木上。見第21個IU。

S.FORM: makasuacu mamia aranai mia tatingikia makasicu mamarurangcikia.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu mamia a[r|ɾ]anai mia tatiŋikia makasiʦu mama[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]aŋʦikia
S.FORM: makasuacu mamia aranai mia tatingikia makasicu mamarurangcikia.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu mamia a[r|ɾ]anai mia tatiŋikia makasiʦu mama[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]aŋʦikia
S.TRANSL: 只有那樣了.從我年紀小,就這樣一直到我老了.
Simply in that way. I am aged from the time of youth this way.

S.FORM: aka cʉpʉng sii 'ancikia tavarʉ'ʉ putukikio.
S.PHON: aka ʦɨpɨŋ sii ʔanʦikia tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ putukikio
S.FORM: aka cʉpʉng sii 'ancikia tavarʉ'ʉ putukikio.
S.PHON: aka ʦɨpɨŋ sii ʔanʦikia tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ putukikio
S.TRANSL: 心裡很難過,因為我不能工作了.
I feel sad because I cannot work.

FORM.notes: source note: nʉkai這個字，發音老師發為nukai。 | source note: su相當於sua。

S.FORM: er nʉkai mamisa ia mama'aricu sii u su cʉngfu ia vʉʉncikia mamarurang um nupasʉ tia 'urupacaa mamarurang mama'aricu cʉpʉng nuu pacʉpʉcʉpʉng.
